description: Wire the MTA-STS enforcement logic into crates/smtp/src/relay_client.rs do_deliver() before the TCP connect at line 118. Sequence: (1) extract recipient domain from envelope, (2) call DNS TXT lookup, (3) if policy id found, check cache; if cache miss or expired, fetch policy via HTTPS, store in cache, (4) call check_mx_against_policy on the peer hostname, (5) if enforce mode and MX not matched: return MtaStsError::MxNotMatched (do not connect), (6) after TLS handshake: if enforce mode and TLS failed: return error, do NOT fall back to plaintext, (7) if testing mode and TLS failed: log failure, record TLSRPT event, proceed. No behavioral change if no MTA-STS policy found for domain.
title: Wire MTA-STS check into relay_client do_deliver()
